description:
Create a customer

Creates a customer record — the client/account profile a job request (work order) is booked against; use it to import or sync customers from your own CRM, website lead form or intake flow. Address (street, city, postal_code, ...) and coordinates (latitude/longitude) live under the nested `address` object. service_area_id must be a valid service area UUID belonging to this business.

country.description: Country (free-form or ISO code). Max 100 chars.

formatted.description: Human-readable single-line address; when set it wins over the discrete parts for display. Max 500 chars.

latitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees (-90..90). Omit if unknown.

line.description: Street address, line 1 (e.g. "123 Main St"). Max 255 chars.

line2.description: Street address, line 2 (apartment, suite, unit). Max 255 chars.

longitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees (-180..180). Omit if unknown.

email.description: Email address. Optional, but at least one of phone/email is required.

full_name.description: Customer's full name. Required; max 255 chars.

idempotency_key.description: Unique key making retries safe: a repeat send with the same key replays the original response (header Idempotent-Replayed: true) instead of re-running the operation. Reusing a key with a different body returns 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE. (sent as the Idempotency-Key header)

phone.description:
Phone number in E.164 international format: a leading `+` and the country
code, e.g. `+16135550188`. A bare national number (`6135550188`) is
REJECTED with PHONE_INVALID — there is no default region to guess the
country from. Separators (spaces, dashes, parentheses) are stripped before
validation. Optional, but at least one of phone/email is required; 10–20 chars.

preferred_technician_id.description: UUID of the technician this customer prefers. Must belong to this business.

service_area_id.description: UUID of the service area for this customer. Must belong to this business.

sms_opt_in.description:
SMS consent: set true ONLY when the customer explicitly agreed to receive
SMS (e.g. ticked a non-pre-checked consent box, or gave verbal/written
consent you keep a record of). SMS notifications are suppressed while false.

tier.description: Loyalty tier. Defaults to "regular" if omitted.

uid.description: Your external reference for this customer (your own system's ID). Optional; max 32 chars.

name: createCustomer
title: Create a customer
